deals_unit_price_pair.name: deals_unit_price_pair
deals_unit_price_pair.value: ("deals"."unit" IS NULL AND "deals"."unit_price" IS NULL) OR ("deals"."unit" IS NOT NULL AND "deals"."unit_price" > 0)

households_budget_period_custom_valid.name: households_budget_period_custom_valid
households_budget_period_custom_valid.value: ("households"."budget_period_type" = 'custom' AND "households"."budget_period_anchor" IS NOT NULL AND "households"."budget_period_length_days" BETWEEN 7 AND 366) OR ("households"."budget_period_type" <> 'custom' AND "households"."budget_period_anchor" IS NULL AND "households"."budget_period_length_days" IS NULL)

pantry_items_stock_levels_check.name: pantry_items_stock_levels_check
pantry_items_stock_levels_check.value: ("pantry_items"."min_quantity" IS NULL AND "pantry_items"."max_quantity" IS NULL) OR ("pantry_items"."min_quantity" >= 0 AND "pantry_items"."max_quantity" > "pantry_items"."min_quantity")

pantry_items_piece_size_check.name: pantry_items_piece_size_check
pantry_items_piece_size_check.value: ("pantry_items"."piece_quantity" IS NULL AND "pantry_items"."piece_unit" IS NULL) OR ("pantry_items"."piece_quantity" > 0 AND "pantry_items"."piece_unit" IS NOT NULL)

product_packages_package_unit_pair.name: product_packages_package_unit_pair
product_packages_package_unit_pair.value: ("product_packages"."package_unit_quantity" IS NULL AND "product_packages"."package_unit" IS NULL) OR ("product_packages"."package_unit_quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "product_packages"."package_unit" IS NOT NULL)

products_product_subtype_requires_type.name: products_product_subtype_requires_type
products_product_subtype_requires_type.value: "products"."product_subtype_id" IS NULL OR "products"."product_type_id" IS NOT NULL

products_product_subtype_source_matches_.name: products_product_subtype_source_matches_id
products_product_subtype_source_matches_.value: ("products"."product_subtype_id" IS NULL AND "products"."product_subtype_source" IS NULL) OR ("products"."product_subtype_id" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."product_subtype_source" IS NOT NULL)

promotion_eligible_items_confidence_rang.name: promotion_eligible_items_confidence_range
promotion_eligible_items_confidence_rang.value: confidence IS NULL OR confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1

promotion_rules_discount_unit_valid.name: promotion_rules_discount_unit_valid
promotion_rules_discount_unit_valid.value: discount_unit IS NULL OR discount_unit IN ('currency','percent','unit_price')

promotion_rules_percent_range.name: promotion_rules_percent_range
promotion_rules_percent_range.value: discount_unit <> 'percent' OR (discount_value IS NOT NULL AND discount_value <= 100)

promotions_validity_order.name: promotions_validity_order
promotions_validity_order.value: valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= valid_from

promotions_confidence_range.name: promotions_confidence_range
promotions_confidence_range.value: confidence IS NULL OR confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1

purchase_items_expense_subcategory_needs.name: purchase_items_expense_subcategory_needs_category
purchase_items_expense_subcategory_needs.value: "purchase_items"."expense_subcategory" IS NULL OR "purchase_items"."expense_category" IS NOT NULL

recurring_income_occurrences_status.name: recurring_income_occurrences_status
recurring_income_occurrences_status.value: ("recurring_income_occurrences"."status" = 'received' AND "recurring_income_occurrences"."income_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("recurring_income_occurrences"."status" = 'skipped' AND "recurring_income_occurrences"."income_id" IS NULL)

recurring_payment_occurrences_status.name: recurring_payment_occurrences_status
recurring_payment_occurrences_status.value: ("recurring_payment_occurrences"."status" = 'paid' AND "recurring_payment_occurrences"."expense_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("recurring_payment_occurrences"."status" = 'skipped' AND "recurring_payment_occurrences"."expense_id" IS NULL)

trade_item_identifiers_validity_range.name: trade_item_identifiers_validity_range
trade_item_identifiers_validity_range.value: "trade_item_identifiers"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "trade_item_identifiers"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "trade_item_identifiers"."valid_until" >= "trade_item_identifiers"."valid_from"
